blocks.text: Match preview: Queensland face Tasmania in 12th Match (TEST) on Wed, 11 Nov, 2026, 6:00 am at The Gabba Brisbane. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.

Variable conditions · High 31°C / Low 19°C · Rain: 21.7 mm · Wind: up to 17 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
